title: Adic continuous Kähler differentials
statement: Let $F$ and $A$ be commutative rings, let $A$ be an $F$-algebra, and let $J\subseteq A$ be an ideal. Using Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], define the $A$-module $\widehat\Omega^J_{A/F}=\varprojlim_{r\geq0}\Omega_{(A/J^r)/F}$ concretely as the submodule of $\prod_{r\geq0}\Omega_{(A/J^r)/F}$ consisting of families $(\omega_r)_r$ such that the map induced by the quotient $A/J^{r+1}\to A/J^r$ sends $\omega_{r+1}$ to $\omega_r$ for every $r\geq0$. The $A$-action on the $r$-th factor is through $A\to A/J^r$.
